title: My neighbourhood app posted my flat 🏘️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 11:48 in the evening, my neighbourhood app warned of a suspicious figure outside flat four.

scenes.narration: At 11:48 in the evening, my neighbourhood app warned of a suspicious figure outside flat four.
Flat four is mine. I was on the sofa. I opened the post with a dry mouth.
A photo. A dark landing. A figure at my front door. Hand raised, ready to knock.
I looked at the door. Locked. The landing light was on. I watched the gap beneath the door. Nothing.
A comment appeared. Don't open the door. Another. He knows you are reading this.
I looked at the photo again. The angle was wrong. It had not been taken from the landing. It was taken from inside my flat, by the window.
I turned around. A new notification. A second photo.
The photo showed my sofa. A person sitting on it. Phone lit. Mouth open.
Then the comments changed. They all said the same thing. It is not him at the door. It is the one who lives there.
So tell me. Do you go out, or stay in?
